Name: OrangePie's DCBurger style ghost girl Cecilia Portraits
Author: OrangePieUwU
Description:
High res portrait of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6246]New NPC - Cecilia[/url] mod Characters ghost girl Cecilia, Since I use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4745]DCBurger's Portrait[/url] for the main game I tried to draw in style that fits with DCBurger's portrait. (asked by MrsCullen.)

Use together with lunakatt's awesome [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9210]Denver portrait[/url] for extra fabulousness xD.


*Make sure you have [b]PyTK[/b] mod (https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726)*
[b][size=4]PYTK unofficial update for 1.5.5: [url=https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/page-78#post-53000]https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/page-78#post-53000[/url]﻿[/size][/b]
Find where you installed your Cecilia mod (somewhere in [b]Stardew Valley\Mods[/b] folder)
Drag the "assets" folder from my Zip to the [b]Stardew Valley\Mods\[CP] Cecilia\assets[/b] folder to overwrite it.



23/08/2021: Uploaded content Patcher version.
I would still recommend the replacement file version since the assets won't get loaded 2 times. But if the replacement file doesn't work for you, try this version.



Need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726]PyTK[/url] to work. (And ofc [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6246]New NPC - Cecilia[/url]﻿ mod.)

The characters belong to the creator of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6246]New NPC - Cecilia[/url]﻿﻿: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/45507937]whitebalverines[/url], please go give them Endorsements and loves.
